title: Joy for your family, kits for your home
summary: The third annual drive-through Magic of Lights holiday lights spectacular will be held at the Brandon Amphitheater from Nov. 20 to Jan. 2. Entergy Mississippi serves as sponsor of the event and will give away energy efficiency kits on two of those nights.
body_markdown:
Santa’s helpers have been busy at the North Pole, preparing a gift that will bring joy and savings this holiday season. Our volunteers will be giving away Entergy Mississippi’s free energy efficiency kits again this year during two nights of the[Magic of Lights](https://url.avanan.click/v2/___https:/magicoflights.com/locations/brandon-ms/___.YXAzOmZhbWlseWVudGVydGFpbm1lbnRsaXZlOmE6bzplYjk5ZDhkNjc5OTk5OTFiZDAwMmNlZGNhN2Q3NDExYTo2OjFhNTg6OGIwMjhiNWQ5YzYwMjlmMzllYTM5NTk0ODdiNjcyNjVkNmUwMjVmYzA1Y2NkNWU5ZDUyZTBkNWU1YzdmMjI2ODpwOlQ6Rg) . The fourth annual drive-through holiday lights spectacular at the Brandon Amphitheater will be open Nov. 20 through Jan. 2, and Entergy Mississippi customers can purchase a discounted ticket and receive a free energy efficient kit.


For a limited time, get a $3 discount using the code **SANTA** when you order tickets before the opening night. Entergy Mississippi customers can enjoy $2 off tickets ordered during the event’s run from Nov. 20 through Jan. 2 by visiting[magicoflights.com/locations/brandon-ms/](https://magicoflights.com/locations/brandon-ms/) and entering the code **POWER** at checkout.


Attendees will delight in more than 2 million vibrant lights on display at the showcase and, on select nights, can pick up Entergy Mississippi’s free kit full of products to help our customers make their homes more energy efficient.


On two nights of the Magic of Lights, cars entering the Magic of Lights will receive a free energy efficiency kit, while supplies last. The exact dates for the energy efficiency kit giveaway will be announced soon. Check the[Entergy Mississippi newsroom](https://www.entergy.com/news/mississippi) for updates.


Produced by Family Entertainment Live, Magic of Lights features dozens of displays, festive favorites, and digital animation, all constructed with millions of individual LED lights to create a memorable holiday experience for the whole family. All guests can take advantage of **$5 Santa photos** in the Jolly Holiday Village, an area which allows visitors to walk through a magical out-of-car area featuring Santa Claus, letter writing stations and other holiday activities. All children will receive an “I SAW SANTA” bracelet.


Here are a few quick facts about the event:


- 12.6 miles of light cord make up the Magic of Lights display.
- 3,750 staff hours are required to set up the event.
- The steel displays are designed, bent, cut and welded into about 800 frames that are combined in different configurations to create the show’s giant winter holiday scenes.
- The Magic of Lights show uses about 10 miles of steel to build the displays and 10 miles of LED lighting installed inside the displays.
- Some of the scenes are as high as 32 feet tall and as long as several hundred feet.


Not able to make it to the Magic of Lights? Entergy Mississippi customers can find discounts on energy-saving products, like smart thermostats and power strips, online at[Entergy Solutions MS Marketplace](https://msentergysolutions-marketplace.com/) .
